All three sites live.

**Dedup**: #3492 (bulk bar) is closed; #3562 / PR #3756 cover trigger-vs-menu consistency, and the body records the scope ruling for why this was not folded in there. No open duplicate.

**Dispatch note**: sequence after PR #3756 lands — it converges data-table's judgment into `isCustomRowActionVisible`, so this card then has exactly three gate sites to fix plus the pin tests the body lists.
